meaning:
ἀλλαχόθεν
adv. (ἀλλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:7 * ;] = ἀλλοθεν (seeMM, VGT, see word)
from another place: Jhn.10:1.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
“Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
